"""PID 1 on the dedicated Pod. Use only the provider-injected Pod credential."""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request


class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
    def redirect_request(self, *args):
        return None


def main():
    pod = os.environ.get("RUNPOD_POD_ID", "")
    key = os.environ.get("RUNPOD_API_KEY", "")
    deadline = float(os.environ["R194_DELETE_EPOCH"])
    assert re.fullmatch(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+", pod) and key
    assert 0 < deadline <= time.time() + 1205
    url = f"https://api.runpod.io/v2/pods/{pod}"
    api = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}), NoRedirect())

    def call(method):
        request = urllib.request.Request(url, method=method, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}"})
        try:
            with api.open(request, timeout=8) as response:
                return response.status
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
            return error.code
        except OSError:
            return 0

    os.umask(0o077)
    root = Path("/tmp/r194")
    root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    # GET verifies read access only. The actual DELETE permission is learned on teardown.
    status = call("GET")
    marker = root / "watchdog-armed.tmp"
    marker.write_text(f"{pod}\n{deadline:.0f}\n{status}\n", encoding="ascii")
    marker.replace(root / "watchdog-armed")
    print("R194 self-GET status", status, flush=True)
    remaining = min(1200, max(0, deadline - time.time()))
    time.sleep(remaining)
    while True:
        status = call("DELETE")
        print("R194 self-DELETE status", status, flush=True)
        if status in (204, 404):
            # Keep PID 1 alive while the provider reconciles deletion.
            time.sleep(60)
        else:
            time.sleep(15)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
